propositions: make amend-msg preserves Change-Id from HEAD but silently drops Signed-off-by trailers when rewriting a commit message via git commit --amend --file
compose_message() reads and re-attaches only Change-Id from HEAD while discarding other trailers including Signed-off-by present on the original commit
git commit --amend -F replaces the entire message wholesale, causing loss of any trailers omitted from the replacement file if not explicitly re-attached by the wrapper
the amend-msg wrapper must carry forward all Signed-off-by trailers from HEAD when the new message file does not supply one, without duplicating if the file already includes sign-offs
existing CI checks do not catch missing Signed-off-by after amend since no gate requires the trailer and check_commit_message_wrap.py only validates wrapping, not presence
